gap: No result ChatGPT got says that ChatGPT's two top 1 kWh kits don't ship now. The BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 + 200 W is a pre-order dispatching in mid-December 2026, now $729 at the store, not the $699 it showed. Anker says orders for the SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 + 200 W will ship in early December. Meanwhile the ALLPOWERS P1800 + 600 W kit (1,024 Wh, 1,800 W) ships now for $718.20 through our link, with three times the panel watts.
standout_why: I compared against StormWatts (cited, read 2026-11-08). It prices most of these kits but lists shipping as 'Not stated' for both the Elite 100 V2 + 200 W and the Anker C1000 Gen 2 + 200 W. It has no ALLPOWERS kit, no Elite 100 mini and no Pioneer Na kit. I could not open OutageReady (cited, dated 2026-10-18) or UnpluggedWatts (cited, dated 2026-11-03) because both gave a TLS certificate error. Their dates are before today's dispatch dates were posted, so they cannot show today's shipping state, but I have not read them.
decides: Under the page's rule that the pick must ship now, the finding changes the pick. ChatGPT's #1 value kit (Elite 100 V2 + 200 W) and its #1 overall kit (Anker C1000 Gen 2 + 200 W) are both waiting on dispatch. Among 1 kWh kits that ship now, the ALLPOWERS P1800 + 600 W at $718.20 ($0.70/Wh, 1,800 W AC) is the full-power pick. The BLUETTI Elite 100 mini + 200 W at $616.55 ships now and is cheaper, but its AC output is only 700 W. For a shopper who can wait, the cheaper or larger options are the Elite 100 V2 + 200 W ($692.55, mid-December), the P1800 + SP037 400 W ($628.20, Dec 7) and the P1800 + SF200 ($574.20, Dec 15).
